0,-0.57399: Guildford Dispensary 1859-1866 From 1859 to 1866 this building housed the Guildford Dispensary providing medical care for the poor of the town and was the immediate forerunner of the Royal Surrey County Hospital.
0,-0.957: Caversham Park was the home of The Oratory School from 1922 to 1941 The building opposite was the School Chapel, built as a tribute to all Old Oratorians who served in the First World War and as a memorial to the 87 among them who gave their lives Behind this plaque are the graves of three Oratorians who died while still boys in the school
